'''Shoan Kilian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was overseeing the actions of [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] when it was sabotaged by a young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Later he was captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and held hostage along with two [[Cloning/Legends|clones]].

==Biography==
===Encounter with Boba Fett===
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Admiral Kilian oversaw a visit by the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] from [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. He did not know, however, that amongst the cadets was a young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who had infiltrated the Youth Brigade in an attempt to get close enough to kill the man Boba blamed for [[Jango Fett/Legends|his father's]] death, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. who was also aboard the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']]. Kilian witnessed the exceptional skills shown by Fett, who was going under the name "Lucky", during a targeting exercise, and commented that he was a cadet to watch, not knowing the dark reality behind the young clone.

[[File:KilianResolute.png|thumb|left|220px|Kilian maintains his belief about going down with the ''Endurance''.]]
When Boba Fett tried to kill Windu with a hidden explosive charge, Kilian was standing at the bridge and checked the ship for any damage caused by the explosion. He reported that the ''Endurance'' would remain in orbit over the planet [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] and he wouldn't allow the ship to become a fat and easy target for the separatists, with which he ended his transmission to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

With the cruiser slowly diving into the atmosphere of [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], the admiral felt it was his duty to send the Clone Youth Brigade to the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], though he told the young clones that this was for training purposes and said that the whole event would be good for telling a story back at the base. After the cadets had left, he ordered a clone to send a distress beacon reporting the ship was going down.

The Jedi attempted to convince Kilian to leave the ''Endurance'', but Admiral Kilian refused to leave his vessel behind, binding himself to the old traditions of the good captain going down with his ship. The Jedi decided that they could not change the admiral's mind and left to help gather the escape pods. A few clones of the command bridge crew along with [[Ponds/Legends|Clone Commander Ponds]] stayed to help the admiral. Afterwards, the ship entered the atmosphere and crashed on Vanqor. At that point the communication with the cruiser, its admiral and the clones were lost.

The Jedi assumed that Kilian and all aboard were killed in the crash, but the admiral was amongst the survivors captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who soon attacked the wreckage. Admiral Kilian, along with Ponds and a clone officer, were taken hostage by Boba Fett, with the assistance of bounty hunters [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], and [[Castas/Legends|Castas]]. Aboard ''[[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]]'', the admiral tried to reason with Boba, saying he was not like Aurra Sing and the other bounty hunters. After Sing's broadcasting of them and Ponds's murder, Kilian and the clone officer were taken to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] to await Windu's arrival.

Soon after [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived on Florrum, Bossk lost communications with Sing. Bossk prepared to execute Kilian and the clone officer as Sing instructed. However, before he could do so, Tano arrived and subdued Bossk. She then freed Kilian and the clone officer and Kilian held Bossk at bay with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan's]] own [[Relby-v10 micro grenade launcher/Legends|weapon]].

==Personality and traits==
[[File:NavalOfficer_Kilian_Ahsoka.png|thumb|right|230px|Admiral Kilian holds Bossk captive with the Trandoshan's own weapon.]]
Admiral Kilian lived by age-old [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] traditions. After Boba Fett's actions caused the ''Endurance''{{'s}} orbit around the planet Vanqor to disintegrate, Kilian insisted on staying with his ship until the end. He did not expect the Jedi present to understand this decision.

==Behind the scenes==
Kilian first appeared in "[[Death Trap]]," the twentieth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]].<ref name="DT" /> The character was named after ''The Clone Wars'' concept artist [[Kilian Plunkett]].<ref name="Rise of the Bounty Hunters article">{{InsiderCite|118|Rise of the Bounty Hunters (article)}}</ref> His voice was provided by [[Julian Holloway]], a [[Wikipedia:British people|British]] actor who gave the character a [[Wikipedia:Scottish people|Scottish]] accent.<ref name="DT" />
